description: Maturity classification for TailTrail CLI commands and MCP tools. Anything not listed here defaults to 'stable' -- this registry only needs to list exceptions, so adding a new command/tool never silently becomes gated by omission. 'stable' always runs. 'incubating'/'experimental' require an explicit --allow-incubating/--allow-experimental flag on the CLI, or are flagged in MCP tool descriptions for the calling host to see. This is a first-pass seed classification based on each feature's own stated scope (read-only bridges, newly-added integrations); it should be reviewed and expanded by the TailTrail team, not treated as exhaustive or final.

aidlc official.reason: Bridges to the external, vendored AWS AI-DLC pack. Read-only/never-executes by design, but the bridge mechanism itself is newer and narrower in real-world use than the core AIDLC lifecycle (aidlc init/check).

spec-kit.reason: Spec Kit import/amendment/convergence integration is a newer, narrower integration surface than the core start/review/completion workflow.

intent-bridge.reason: Alias surface for the Spec Kit integration; same rationale as 'spec-kit'.
